The Wizards defeated the Bulls, 98-94 tonight in Chicago. Anthony Davis finished with a team-high 36 points along with 11 rebounds and 3 assists for the Wizards, while AJ Dybantsa tallied 20 points, 10 rebounds and 6 assists in the game. Norman Powell recorded 16 points, 3 rebounds and 2 assists. The Wizards improve their record to 6-11 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 4-11 for the season.
